description:
Validate vault files against the schemas.

Usage: lint [PATH ...] [--quiet] [--schemas DIR]

Args:
  PATH: zero or more files to validate. With none, lint walks the whole vault.

Flags:
  --quiet  no per-violation output; exit code only
  --schemas DIR  schemas directory (default: the schemas bundled with the package). Do not pass it

Examples:
  []
  ["--quiet"]

Notes:
  Read-only.
  Each violation prints as <absolute path>:<line>: <message>. Files that are not valid UTF-8 are reported here and skipped by every other command.
  Exit 0: clean. Exit 1: violations found. Exit 2: no schemas loaded.
